request: 50 additional distinct review passes, emphasizing useful coverage and fewer false warnings.
passDefinition: One labeled execution context per pass. These 50 additional focused contexts vary source, wrapper, namespace, analysis bound or runner contract; they are not 50 independent repository audits or a claim of exhaustive semantic coverage.

admission.existingOwner: SARJ510 owns this explicit data-union modeling preference.
admission.demonstratedGap: Native-valid Final and public dunder tags, qualified imported aliases and callable Pydantic discriminators could warn; transparent final records and nested Literal overlaps could be missed.
admission.harm: False warnings pressure developers to change valid constructor or serialization contracts; missed supported unions weaken the requested policy.
admission.boundary: Nominal unions remain valid Python. Preserve the warning severity, conservative unsupported-form exclusions and no-autofix contract.
admission.smallestFix: Refine the existing bounded AST helper; add no overlapping rule or name-based type heuristic.

labeled.qualification: Unsupported forms are explicitly labeled abstentions rather than counted as supported positive coverage.

refinements: Unwrap bounded local aliases and transparent Final qualifiers before evaluating candidate fields.
Preserve public __dunder__ tag names while excluding name-mangled private fields.
Keep primitive type identity in Literal keys: False and 0 are distinct static literal types. Native identity-branch narrowing verifies the distinction.
Expand nested Literal operands and local literal aliases under a shared finite expansion budget; overlapping domains still warn.
Recognize import-proven typing final decorators around direct data records while preserving unknown-decorator and rebinding exclusions.
Respect import-proven Pydantic callable Discriminator metadata, including Field nesting and optional union wrappers; require coverage of every non-None branch.
Resolve module-level discriminator metadata independently of unrelated local parameter shadowing; preserve module mutation/rebinding controls.
Keep qualified imported/computed tag domains uncertain and retain finite evidence in partially unresolved domains, preventing a missing-tag conclusion from discarded information.
nativeEvidence: Runtime construction, asdict output and BasedPyright assert_type narrowing pass for Final instance tags, ClassVar[Final] tags, public dunder tags and TypeAliasType field aliases.
Boolean/integer identity dispatch passes both runtime and BasedPyright; the prior bool/int-equality assumption is corrected in the original fixture.
Owner-private Pydantic TypeAdapter runtime and BasedPyright witnesses pass for direct and Field-wrapped callable discriminators. Additional optional-wrapper witnesses pass native runtime validation.
supplementalControls: Seven callable scope/coverage controls and two field-name discriminator controls sit outside the 50-pass ledger. String Discriminator field names still require Literal tags; an uncovered third record still warns.

upstreamReview.result: No maintained shared data-union discriminator design rule replaces SARJ510.
Nested Literal aliases are valid; literal equivalence preserves primitive type identity.
Final dataclass fields and nested ClassVar/Final are valid contracts.
Callable discriminators can identify variants without a shared literal field.

limitations: Runtime TypeAliasType union declarations, closed TypedDict keyword configurations and Pydantic ConfigDict-bearing record bodies remain intentional abstentions; field aliases using TypeAliasType are treated as uncertain.
Inherited, generic, behavior-bearing or dynamically modified records and unresolved imported variants remain excluded.
Imported tag domains are not resolved across files. Uncertainty handling avoids claiming proof where a candidate finite discriminator may already exist.
Literal expansion, record alias expansion and subgroup discrimination are bounded; complex or opaque domains abstain. No autofix changes constructors or wire formats.
The 50-case ledger and inspected local corpora do not establish population-wide precision or complete recall.
reproduce: code-standards --root . maintain rules changes --before origin/main --after HEAD

corpus.visibility: Owner-readable pinned local overlay; identities, paths, revisions, source and private hashes are omitted.
corpus.qualification: All eight live matches were inspected against the explicit modeling policy; this is not a population precision estimate.

performanceNotes.method: Medians of three paired baseline/candidate repeats, with a fresh linter process per corpus/bounded batch. Cold means the first pass in an interpreter; warm means its second pass, not a cleared OS cache.
performanceNotes.runtime: CPython 3.15.0 on a shared Linux VM.
performanceNotes.combinedScope: All registered per-file rules on the same deterministic 30-file panel across three pinned corpora; project discovery is excluded.
performanceNotes.interpretation: Shared VM contention affects wall time. These measurements support regression review and make no optimization or population-wide speed claim.
